ask-nick-reply-fix.ref: statenour/ask-nick-reply-fix (job 2026-10-18-ask-nick-reply-fix, 2026-10-18). Root cause: components/home/nick-command-line.tsx built a bare DefaultChatTransport while POST /api/ai/chat always answers in the cockpit SSE format (lib/ai/runtime/sse-stream.ts), so the AI SDK parser threw on the first named frame, useChat went to error, and the box never read error. Change: the SSE decoding block of hooks/chat/use-chat-transport.ts moved to lib/chat/decode-cockpit-sse.ts (decodeCockpitSseResponse, patchResumeStart moved with it); a line-for-line compare of the moved block against the base shows 4 differing lines only (res.body non-null assertion, two comment em dashes to ASCII, toast.error replaced by the caller's onDecodeError, which the hook passes with the same toast text and duration). The command line's transport (still useMemo with []) wraps fetch with the decoder and keeps body ephemeral true; it reads status, adds an always-mounted role=status aria-live=polite region with 'Nick is working...' (and 'Still working. This one is slow.' after 20 s) and, on an error or a finish with no assistant text, 'Nick did not answer. Try again.' (or 'Nick stopped before finishing. Try again.' when partial text had arrived) with a 44 px Try again button that drops the failed turn and re-sends its text under a fresh id; when the broken turn carries a tool part that lib/ai/chat/message-side-effect.ts messageMayHaveWritten cannot vouch for, the button is withheld and the line says something may already have run. New tests: tests/components/nick-command-line-round-trip.test.tsx (jsdom, real useChat, real createCockpitSseStream inside withHeartbeat, only fetch stubbed): 6 failed / 0 passed on the unfixed component (T1 DOM showed only 'You: plan my day', the live symptom), 6 passed after; manager review round: the no-text sentence shortened and T2e (partial text, then a break) added, 4 failed / 3 passed against c6ac4682f, 7 passed after. tests/lib/chat/decode-cockpit-sse.test.ts: 6 passed (split frame, URL-safe base64 without padding, bare data frame, ping comments, one onDecodeError for two bad chunks, message.persisted with the response trace id). Mutants 5 / 5 killed: partial text given the no-answer sentence (T2e red), no fetch wrapper (5 red), error swallowed (4 red), no 20 s switch (1 red), currentEvent reset per read (2 red, one of them the unmodified tests/hooks/use-chat-transport-sse-split.test.ts). Regression set, files unmodified: the 7 tests/hooks/use-chat-transport*.test.ts, nick-command-line-live-region, nick-command-line-routing, ephemeral-keeps-tools, home-hydration-safety, escalation-visibility, chat-resume-regenerate-gate, use-chat-stream-glue, plus the two new files: 17 files, 267 passed. tsc --noEmit exit 0; eslint on the 5 touched source and test files exit 0, no output; tests/repo/ui-v3-ratchets.test.ts 60 passed, 1 skipped. Not run: check:anti-slop (needs bash, not on this Windows PATH), the full app suite, any browser or live check.
